meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 给助手加上 Signal 渠道：用 signal-cli 设备链接，把你手机上已有的 Signal 号码当作助手收发账号，无需新号码。它会安装 signal-cli、注册适配器、引导扫码链接、保存账号并接线。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 添加 Signal 渠道时触发，例如在 /setup 流程中，或直接要求把 Signal 账号接进来。它会接管安装、链接与接线步骤。

say.text: 帮我把 Signal 接入 NanoClaw，用设备链接方式
say.note: 会安装 signal-cli 并引导你扫码链接

say.text: 把这个 Signal 号码设为助手账号，然后重启服务
say.note: 写入 SIGNAL_ACCOUNT 后重启并绑定

howto.what_en: Adds a Signal channel via signal-cli device-link: your existing phone number becomes the account the assistant sends and receives with, no new number. It installs signal-cli, walks through the QR link and wires it up.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to add a Signal channel to NanoClaw — for example during the /setup flow or when asking to connect a Signal account. It handles install, linking and wiring.

say_en.text: Add Signal to NanoClaw using the device-link flow
say_en.note: Installs signal-cli and guides the QR scan

say_en.text: Set this Signal number as the assistant account and restart
say_en.note: Writes SIGNAL_ACCOUNT, restarts and binds it

say_en.text: Wire the new Signal chat to an agent with /manage-channels
